intro: Connect Its a Plan to see your boards and assigned tickets here, in EinHub and via EinChat. Create a personal API key in Its a Plan under Account → API keys.
hint: Open tickets assigned to you now appear in EinHub, and EinChat can list your boards and tickets.
invalidKey: Its a Plan rejected this API key.
boardsEmpty: No boards — you are not a member of any itsaplan project.
ticketsEmpty: No open tickets assigned to you — all done.
